انتهكن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَكْنَ (intahakna) /in.ta.hak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اُنْتُهِكْنَ (untuhikna) /un.tu.hik.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اِنْتَهِكْنَ (intahikna) /in.ta.hik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
